records.people: Jaime Valencia Valencia (Gerente General of the Banco Central de Bolivia, sworn in 16 January 2020)
records.move: from senior posts at the insurer Compañía Boliviana de Seguros S.A., Banco de Cochabamba and Banco de la Unión S.A. to Gerente General of the Banco Central de Bolivia (16 January 2020)
records.summary: The central bank's own press note of 16 January 2020 says the economist Jaime Valencia Valencia was sworn in as Gerente General and had held senior posts at Banco de la Union S.A., Banco de Cochabamba and Compania Boliviana de Seguros S.A., among other firms. On the insurer's side, an obituary for the insurance executive Gonzalo Bedoya states that Compania Boliviana de Seguros S.A. was founded in 1946 by Bolivian and Peruvian businesspeople, and the successor firm La Boliviana Ciacruz's own history page says the 1946 capital was 62 percent Peruvian and 38 percent Bolivian. Neither page states the ownership of Banco de Cochabamba, which the financial supervisor's 1999 annual report lists only as an entity in liquidation, and Banco de la Union S.A. is state-linked, so only the insurer is recorded as a private employer here.
records.source_title: NP 005/2020 - BCB tiene nuevo Gerente General (Banco Central de Bolivia)
records.quote: Ferroviaria Oriental S.A., Banco de la Union S.A., Banco de Cochabamba, Compania Boliviana de Seguros S.A.

records.move: from Minister of Economy and Industry (August 2019) and earlier Minister of Employment and Vocational Training (2007-2008) and director general of the savings and credit network PROCAPEC, to Governor of the Banque Centrale de Mauritanie (21 January 2020)
